gloss: sleeping outdoors; camping out in the open

definitions.gloss: sleeping outdoors; camping out (without a tent or proper shelter); roughing it
definitions.explanation: Spending the night outside without staying at an inn, house, or formal campsite. The image is of sleeping on the ground, under the stars, in a park, a {河原|かわら} ('riverbed'), a mountain, or a {駅|えき} ('station'). It does not require a tent; pitching a tent at a designated campground is usually called キャンプ rather than {野宿|のじゅく}. Can be chosen (travelers, adventurers) or unavoidable (hikers caught by darkness, people without a place to stay).

examples.japanese: ⟦{河原|かわら}→河原：28759_kawara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To sleep outdoors by the riverbank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れて→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I missed the last train and ended up sleeping outside in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{羽目|はめ}→羽目：11113_hame⟧になった。
examples.english: We got lost on the mountain trail and ended up having to sleep outdoors.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧バックパッカー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧や⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しくない→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧。
examples.english: For backpackers without money, sleeping in parks or on beaches is not unusual.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{野|の}→野：03535_no⟧ ('field; open country; outdoors') and ⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧/{宿|しゅく} ('lodging'). Literally 'lodging in the open'. Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ and is commonly used as a verbal noun: {野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to sleep outdoors').

USAGE:
- Often used with a location particle: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.
- Compatible with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, and ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ ('ended up sleeping outdoors').
- Carries neither a strongly positive nor strongly negative nuance on its own; context determines whether it sounds adventurous, pitiful, or reckless.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sleep outdoors
- {野宿|のじゅく}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a rough-sleeping lifestyle
- {野宿|のじゅく}⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: experience of sleeping outside
- {野宿|のじゅく}⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: a trip involving sleeping outdoors
- {野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{羽目|はめ}→羽目：11113_hame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up having to sleep outside
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sleep at a train station

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧: camping — implies tent, sleeping bag, and a planned outdoor stay; more recreational.
- ⟦{露営|ろえい}→露営：24212_roei⟧: bivouac; encampment — formal, often military or mountaineering.
- {寝|ね}{泊|と}まり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stay overnight (anywhere, including indoors) — much broader.
- ⟦{路上|ろじょう}→路上：19441_rojou⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: street living; rough sleeping as a way of life — describes homelessness, not a one-time event.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Associated in popular imagination with budget travelers, long-distance hikers, and pilgrimage (⟦お{遍路|へんろ}→お遍路：19059_ohenro⟧) culture. In urban settings, ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野宿|のじゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ often implies missing the last train rather than genuine homelessness.
